description: Undo the last neat_apply_extension for a given library. Removes the dep from package.json and the registration from the hook file. Does not re-run the package manager — run install manually to sync the lockfile.

library.description: The library whose instrumentation should be rolled back

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: neat_rollback_extension
